title: Direct sums of uniformly bounded families
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $\Lambda=\underline E$ or $\underline{\Qlb}$ be the condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and let $p:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. For $T=X,Y$, use the pulled-back coefficient ring $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], its category of module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and its unbounded derived category $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], in the fixed site and indexing universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $\operatorname{IndCons}(T,\Lambda)$ for the module sheaves that are small filtered colimits, in $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$, of constructible module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and $D_{\mathrm{ic}}(T,\Lambda)$ for the full subcategory whose cohomology sheaves belong to $\operatorname{IndCons}(T,\Lambda)$ in every degree. Let $F=Rp_*$ be the total right derived functor of module pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $I$ be any small set, $a,b\in\mathbf Z$, and $(M_\alpha)_{\alpha\in I}$ a family in $D_{\mathrm{ic}}(X,\Lambda)$ satisfying $H^r(M_\alpha)=0$ whenever $r<a$ or $r>b$. For the ambient derived coproducts, the canonical comparison
$$
\eta_M:\bigoplus_{\alpha\in I}F(M_\alpha)\longrightarrow F\Bigl(\bigoplus_{\alpha\in I}M_\alpha\Bigr),
\qquad \eta_M\circ\iota_\alpha=F(\iota_\alpha),
$$
is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$.

proof.text: The pulled-back internal module category C is Grothendieck abelian by lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck, with the K-injective framework already supplied by the module derived category. Its colimits give coproducts of size u+1. Apply lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts to obtain a coproduct c of the given family in the ambient unbounded derived category.

Properness supplies quasi-compactness and separatedness; separatedness supplies quasi-separatedness. For each i and r<a the left disjunct of the given interval-vanishing hypothesis gives H^r(M_i)=0. Thus every M_i is GE a by the standard derived t-structure. Apply the existing stronger lem-sfb-adic-proper-bounded-below-coproducts with N=a, first to the finite-subextension condensed coefficient ring and then to the finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient ring. This proves that the actual total right derived module pushforward F preserves the discrete diagram M. The upper bound and ind-constructibility hypothesis are not needed by this stronger result. This supplies the unit bounded-family step without bypassing it or the subsequent arbitrary-family step.

Define d to have vertex F(c.pt) and legs F.map(c.inj i). Preservation of this coproduct, transported through the standard equivalence between mapped cocones and cofans, makes d a colimit. Choose c and d in the asserted existential statement. Its displayed comparison is then exactly hd.desc d. The colimit hom-ext principle and its coprojection equations identify hd.desc d with the identity, which is invertible. This universal-property argument applies to an empty indexing type, equal bounds and reversed bounds without any case split.

proof_origin.place: Bounded-family comparison, using the already published stronger bounded-below condensed-module theorem lem-sfb-adic-proper-bounded-below-coproducts (Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Lemma 5.3(1)); coproduct universal properties identify the canonical comparison with the identity. C9, 2026-10-18.
